data.title: 蕾塞 · 暴雨电话亭·狭小空间与湿发回眸
data.description: 狂风暴雨席卷的东京街头，狭小而闷热的红色公用电话亭成了唯一的避难所。湿透的短发紧贴着蕾塞白皙的脸颊，雨水顺着她的脖颈流淌进衣领。她转过身在极近的距离凝视着你——「这里好挤……但是很暖和呢。电次君，心跳声吵得我都要听不清外面的雨声了。」
data.promptProse: From inside a narrow red-painted metal phone booth, Reze turns her face back over her shoulder to meet the viewer's eyes. One wet lock lies against her cheek above the pin choker and white collar. The black telephone handset hangs on its curled cord just below her shoulder beside the payphone. A red vertical frame borders the close view, and the street lamps outside dissolve into amber reflections through the rain on the glass. A small cool booth lamp lights one edge of her fringe.
data.action: 湿发回眸，雨幕模糊街景
data.lighting: soft streetlamp glow through rain-streaked booth glass at night
data.animaCaption: Inside the narrow red-painted booth she turns just her head toward the viewer, with wet bangs against her cheek. The black handset hangs by its cord next to her shoulder and rain beads on the glass.
